queries.sql: SELECT 42 AS answer, CASE WHEN 7 * 6 = 42 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END AS status
SELECT j.id, j.name, j.status FROM JSONTABLE(CAST('{"id":5,"name":"carly","status":"sold"}' AS json), '$', false COLUMNS id integer, name string, status string) AS j
SELECT id, name, region FROM local.CUSTOMERS WHERE id = 17
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, SUM(id) AS id_sum FROM local.CUSTOMERS GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM local.CUSTOMERS AS c JOIN local.ORDERS AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
SELECT customer_id, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS row_position FROM local.ORDERS WHERE customer_id <= 8 ORDER BY customer_id, row_position
